observed_condition: All four successful native children reported SIG_DFL; both Python children reported SIG_IGN and reached query return 0 then a pending poll. This is correlation in the admitted original ARM run, not a causal diagnosis.

primary_sources.finding: signal_install_handlers installs SIGPIPE ignore; the pinned v3.12.10 source agrees with the observed original Python child disposition.

PyOS_setsig constructs a new action with an empty mask and SA_ONSTACK. The experiment therefore uses the same narrow C setter for both contexts, rather than changing unrelated action fields through this Python path.
CDLL keeps the existing GIL-release call policy and passes explicit flags to dlopen; no PyDLL arm is introduced.

The public implementation sets SO_NOSIGPIPE on a newly created socket; shared operations reuse the primary connection. QueryRecordInternal calls ConnectToServer and deliver_request. This does not supply a demonstrated process-wide SIGPIPE mechanism for the observed pending poll.

The default SOL_SOCKET getter for SO_NOSIGPIPE reads the SOF_NOSIGPIPE flag into an int and copies it out; it does not clear the flag. Socket filters/protocol admission may still refuse the operation, which must be retained as observed failure.
Public getsockopt declaration uses int,int,int,void*,socklen_t*. The platform header defines SOL_SOCKET and SO_NOSIGPIPE; source will use those names and sizeof(int), not a Python ABI cast.

documentation.finding: Python documents its default SIGPIPE ignore behavior and main-thread handler-setting restriction. Installed original Python was 3.12.10; its exact tag source is separately bound above.
Archived public socket option ABI documentation; current installed implementation is not proven by this page.
Archived public signal action read/set API documentation; actual installed action values must be observed.

source_attribution_limit: These independently fetched primary source versions support the design. No Apple repository commit is claimed to be the exact source of the installed macOS 15.7.9 SDK/runtime libraries.

design.installation_boundary: Same C export in the held, same newly built phase image, called after dlopen/configure on the owned child main thread and before the unchanged query entrypoint. This tests query-time disposition, not image-initialization behavior.
design.setter: Read complete prior sigaction, require a default/ignored original handler, copy it and change only sa_handler. Read back requested handler and unchanged flags/action mask/blocked mask. Restore exact prior action on returning paths and record every failed/readback/restore result.
design.socket_observation: One read-only getsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_NOSIGPIPE,int*,socklen_t*) after the existing exact endpoint record and before original poll. Record return/errno/length/raw integer. Do not set the option, read SO_ERROR, duplicate the descriptor, or infer daemon/OFD identity.
design.protocol: Separately versioned result and strict adapter; validate exact inserted record order/condition before passing the remaining original records to unchanged endpoint/phase parsers.
design.cleanup: Same existing capture retirement rules. Missing post-query or restoration observations after SIGKILL are unavailable, never inferred from process retirement. Always-run final source/image/runtime witness must retain unavailable inputs.
design.interpretation: Compare actual eight same-host cells only; failures, unsupported getters, altered action fields, output limits, missing identities or incomplete cleanup prevent admission. No expected fix or causal mechanism is asserted.

unresolved.Intel: The repeated original five-second xcrun compiler-discovery timeout remains a separate environment admission failure; no retry or compiler-path substitution is authorized here.
